combinations.readout: anti-nociceptive effect (paw withdrawal threshold) in SNI neuropathic pain
combinations.magnitude: combination greater than EC5026 or Ricolinostat alone (p<0.05 vs EC5026 group)
combinations.evidence_quote: Therefore, the co-administration of Ricolinostat and EC5026 could produce synergistic effects on attenuating SNI-induced neuropathic pain in mice.
